title: scopetest affected executor
description: Run only the test files of this project that are affected by changes since the base ref.

runner.description: Test runner to invoke. `auto` picks based on the config file in the project root.

base.description: Git ref to compare against. Defaults to $NX_BASE, then `defaultBase` from nx.json, then main/master.

command.description: Custom command run from the project root instead of the built-in runner. `{}` is replaced by the affected test files (relative to the project root).

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the test runner, e.g. ["--coverage"].

threshold.description: If more than this many test files of the project are affected, run the project's whole suite instead.

runAllOnConfigChange.description: Run the project's whole suite when files scopetest cannot trace changed (lockfiles, root package.json, nx.json, tsconfig.base.json, jest preset, or the project's own config files).

noCache.description: Rebuild the scopetest dependency graph instead of using the cache.
